rounds.text: Vivo Bio Tech Ltd is heavily mispriced by the market, trading at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.55x against a book value of ₹ 42.0 while sitting at a modest ₹ 23.2 per share [E1]. This valuation anomaly is further highlighted by its key-ratios P/B of 0.52x, which looks remarkably cheap when compared against the sector benchmark of 4.07x [E6]. Beneath this depressed pricing, recent operational momentum is undeniably turning positive, evidenced by an 11% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E16], year-over-year sales increasing by 14% [E58], sequential sales rising quarter-over-quarter [E60], and accelerating earnings growth [E61]. Furthermore, the company's return on capital employed of 6.64% closely matches the sector benchmark of 6.38% [E9], demonstrating competitive efficiency despite its tiny ₹ 51.5 Cr market capitalisation [E2]. Conceded: [E3], [E4], [E14], [E17], [E23], [E54].
